subsystems.name: Foldable display
subsystems.role: provides a large, continuous screen that bends repeatedly without breaking.

subsystems.name: Hinge
subsystems.role: allows the device to fold and unfold thousands of times while keeping the screen flat.

subsystems.name: AI compute silicon
subsystems.role: runs the operating system and local transformer models.
parts: system-on-chip with CPU, GPU and neural processing unit (NPU)

subsystems.name: Power system
subsystems.role: supplies energy in a thin, split form factor.

subsystems.name: Thermal management
subsystems.role: spreads heat from the chip and display so the device can run AI workloads without throttling.

subsystems.name: Software and AI runtime
subsystems.role: compiles, quantises and executes AI models on the NPU.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the flexible OLED
buildSteps.detail: Organic light-emitting layers are deposited on a polyimide backplane, then sealed with thin-film encapsulation to keep out moisture and oxygen.

buildSteps.title: Make the cover glass
buildSteps.detail: Ultra-thin glass is etched, chemically strengthened and laminated to the display so it can bend without shattering.

buildSteps.title: Build the hinge
buildSteps.detail: Precision metal parts are machined and assembled into a multi-link hinge, then cycled in a test rig to check durability.

buildSteps.title: Produce the AI chip
buildSteps.detail: The system-on-chip is fabricated at an advanced node and includes dedicated NPU cores alongside CPU and GPU.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the display module
buildSteps.detail: The OLED panel is bonded to the cover glass and attached to the hinge, then calibrated for colour and touch.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the device
buildSteps.detail: Mainboard, split battery, cameras, antennae and speakers are fitted into the two halves, with flexible cables crossing the hinge.

buildSteps.title: Prepare the AI models
buildSteps.detail: Models are quantised and compiled for the NPU, then preloaded so the device can run generative tasks locally.

buildSteps.title: Test and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: The finished tablet is folded and unfolded thousands of times, thermally stressed, and benchmarked on AI inference.

prerequisites.why: commercially deployed in foldable phones and tablets.
used as a bendable cover material in shipping foldables.
dedicated AI accelerators exist in phones and tablets, but running large generative models locally is still emerging.
small language and image models run on devices today, but full creative suites need more memory and speed.
split-cell designs are already used in foldable devices.

pathway.milestone: foldable tablets with NPUs for camera and photo AI
pathway.unlocks: a large screen that fits in a bag, with basic on-device intelligence.

pathway.milestone: local language models for summarisation, search and chat
pathway.unlocks: private AI that works offline without sending data to the cloud.

pathway.milestone: real-time generative image and video editing on the device
pathway.unlocks: creative work that previously needed a desktop GPU or cloud service.

pathway.milestone: persistent on-device AI agents that manage tasks across apps
pathway.unlocks: a tablet that acts as an autonomous assistant rather than a passive screen.
